answer.evidence: radon/raw.py:177-181 holds the helper that checks whether a token list is a single token of the requested type followed only by ENDMARKER, NL or NEWLINE tokens. It is built on tokens[1:] and a check of TOKEN_NUMBER(t) in (EM, NL, NEWLINE). Review points: (1) behaviour on an empty list, where the first-token check could raise IndexError or return a wrong result; (2) whether the first token is compared against token_number correctly; (3) the callers at raw.py:154-169, which filter COMMENT/NL/NEWLINE with _fewer_tokens before the check, so the interaction with the colon and ENDMARKER handling needs tests. radon/visitors.py is the second review target, to check whether it has similar token or AST end-of-sequence logic that should stay consistent. radon/complexity.py and radon/metrics.py got a quick skim only, since grep found no matching token-sequence logic in them.
